misleadingCurrencySymbols.note: A bare $ is ambiguous across dollar currencies; the model must keep amount and null the currency rather than guess USD.
Guessed separator decimals are rejected by the canonical amount shape; ambiguous separators require null amount and null currency.
65.000 reads as sixty-five thousand only with VND context from rawText; a bare 65.000 amount without that context is a different value.
Yen has no minor units; a decimal yen amount would be suspect and needs customer review.

repeatedNames.note: The same printed name on two pages is one dish for deduplication (both source references kept), not two invented dishes; two identical names with different prices must be flagged for review.

Rejected: malformed decimals fail the canonical amount shape.
Rejected: an empty amount string is not a price; unpriced items use null.
Rejected: only supported ISO 4217 monetary currencies; unknown codes use null.
